links.comparator_used: Control clinics received the opioid-risk handout without any suicide risk alert (usual care; CSSRS available but no model-based flag)
links.outcome: Completion of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale within 14 days of a primary care visit among patients in the top 5% of estimated suicide risk
links.quote: Over a mean follow-up of 249 days, 20.3% of intervention patients and 17.4% of control patients had at least 1 Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale completed in the next 14 days (p=0.70).

design_hint: Clinical decision support alert of predicted suicide risk prompting structured screening
